rows.source: Hold it, tune it, play your first notes.
rows.translation: Uchopte gitaru, nalaďte ju a zahrajte prvé tóny.

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 6.
rows.translation: Najhrubšia struna znie najnižšie. Pri hre je najbližšie k vašej tvári. Označujeme ju ako strunu 6.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Each string has a tuning peg on the head. Turning it changes the pitch. Timbre listens and tells you which way.
rows.translation: Každá struna má na hlave gitary ladiaci kolík. Otáčaním meníte výšku tónu. Timbre počúva a povie vám, ktorým smerom otáčať.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (6).
rows.translation: Struny číslujeme od najtenšej (1) po najhrubšiu (6).
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pluck the thickest string and let it ring.
rows.translation: Brnknite na najhrubšiu strunu a nechajte ju znieť.

rows.source: E minor uses two fingers on fret 2, strings 5 and 4. Every string rings.
rows.translation: E mol hráte dvoma prstami na pražci 2, na strunách 5 a 4. Znejú všetky struny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Brush across all six strings from thick to thin, one smooth motion. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: Jedným plynulým pohybom prejdite cez všetkých šesť strún od hrubej po tenkú. Zápästie nechajte uvoľnené.

rows.source: This challenge mixes the whole unit: the open strings, E, F and G on string 1, and E minor. Take a breath between steps.

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: open string 2 is B, fret 2 on string 3 is A, and open string 3 is G. Your second finger plays the A.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb vystačí s troma tónmi: prázdna struna 2 je B, pražec 2 na strune 3 je A a prázdna struna 3 je G. Tón A hráte druhým prstom.

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's A.

rows.source: Notes on strings 1 and 2, reading tab, and your first two tunes.
rows.translation: Tóny na strunách 1 a 2, čítanie tabulatúry a prvé dve melódie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 2 works like string 1. Open, it's B. Fret 1 with your first finger is C. Fret 3 with your third finger is D.
rows.translation: Na strune 2 to funguje rovnako ako na strune 1. Prázdna znie B. Pražec 1 stlačený prvým prstom dá tón C. Pražec 3 stlačený tretím prstom dá tón D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Brnknite na prázdnu strunu 2. To je B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 2, fret 1, first finger. That's C.
rows.translation: Struna 2, pražec 1, prvý prst. To je C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 2, fret 3, third finger. That's D.
rows.translation: Struna 2, pražec 3, tretí prst. To je D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: One finger per fret: fret 1 gets finger 1, fret 2 gets finger 2, fret 3 gets finger 3.
rows.translation: Jeden prst na každý pražec: pražec 1 patrí prstu 1, pražec 2 prstu 2 a pražec 3 prstu 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Rest your thumb on the back of the neck, behind your second finger. Your fingers can then arch and land on their tips.
rows.translation: Palec oprite o zadnú stranu krku oproti druhému prstu. Prsty tak môžete zaobliť a položiť na struny končekmi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Tab draws six lines, one per string, with string 1 on top. A number on a line is the fret to press. A 0 means play that string open.
rows.translation: Tabulatúra má šesť čiar, jednu pre každú strunu; struna 1 je navrchu. Číslo na čiare označuje pražec, ktorý stlačíte. 0 znamená prázdnu strunu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In tab, a 3 on the top line means…
rows.translation: Číslo 3 na hornej čiare tabulatúry znamená…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The top line is string 1, the thinnest. The number is the fret.
rows.translation: Horná čiara je struna 1, tá najtenšia. Číslo označuje pražec.

rows.source: A note that lasts two beats
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A half note rings for two beats. Pick once, count one, two, and let it sustain until the next note.
rows.translation: Polová nota znie dve doby. Brnknite raz, počítajte raz, dva a nechajte tón znieť až po ďalšiu notu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How long does a half note last?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Half of a four-beat bar is two beats. A quarter note lasts one beat.
rows.translation: Polovica štvordobého taktu trvá dve doby. Štvrťová nota trvá jednu dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Going from string 2 to string 1 is a tiny move. Keep your picking hand close to the strings so the next note is ready.
rows.translation: Zo struny 2 na strunu 1 je to malý pohyb. Ruku, ktorou brnkáte, držte blízko strún, aby bola pripravená na ďalší tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fret 3 on string 2, then open string 1. Lift your finger as you pick.
rows.translation: Pražec 3 na strune 2, potom prázdna struna 1. Pri brnknutí zdvihnite prst.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1.
rows.translation: C a D na strune 2, potom E, F a G na strune 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: This melody comes from Beethoven's Ninth Symphony. It uses C, D, E, F and G, and it moves mostly one step at a time.
rows.translation: Táto melódia pochádza z Beethovenovej Deviatej symfónie. Používa C, D, E, F a G a väčšinou postupuje po susedných tónoch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The first line, slowly: E E F G G F E D.
rows.translation: Prvý riadok pomaly: E E F G G F E D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Then: C C D E E D D.
rows.translation: Potom: C C D E E D D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Each line ends with a lilt: a longer note, a quick one, then a held one. Count one-and-two, and slip the quick note in on the and.
rows.translation: Každý riadok sa končí zhúpnutím: dlhší tón, krátky tón a potom podržaný tón. Počítajte „raz-a-dva“ a krátky tón zahrajte na „a“.

rows.source: This nursery tune walks on C, D and E, then jumps up to G. The jump is open string 1 to fret 3.
rows.translation: Táto detská melódia kráča po C, D a E a potom skočí nahor na G. Je to skok z prázdnej struny 1 na jej pražec 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: E D C D E E E: open string 1, down to string 2 and back.
rows.translation: E D C D E E E: prázdna struna 1, nadol na strunu 2 a späť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D D D on string 2, then E and G on string 1.
rows.translation: D D D na strune 2, potom E a G na strune 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Letters in a Shoebox is a Timbre Original, a slow ballad in C. Its chorus lives on strings 1 and 2, and its hook opens with the long, short lilt you played in Ode to Joy. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Listy v krabici od topánok sú autorská pieseň Timbre, pomalá balada v C. Refrén hráte na strunách 1 a 2 a jeho motív začína dlhým a krátkym tónom ako v Óde na radosť. Celá pieseň je v časti Piesne pod Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The hook: C and D on string 2, then E, F and G on string 1, and back to D.
rows.translation: Motív: C a D na strune 2, potom E, F a G na strune 1 a späť na D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Does the chorus end at home?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No, it wants to go on
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: E, F and G on string 1, B, C and D on string 2. Start slow, then hold a steady tempo.
rows.translation: Nič nové: E, F a G na strune 1, B, C a D na strune 2. Začnite pomaly a potom držte stále tempo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Ktorý tón znie na prázdnej strune 2?

rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: All six notes, low to high.
rows.translation: Všetkých šesť tónov od nízkeho po vysoký.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Ode to Joy, a little faster
rows.translation: Óda na radosť o niečo rýchlejšie
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb, faster
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb rýchlejšie
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: E minor, E, A minor and A, played cleanly, and your first chord changes.
rows.translation: E mol, E, A mol a A s čistým zvukom a vaše prvé zmeny akordov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Press with your fingertips, arched like a bridge, so no finger leans on the string below it. Short nails make this much easier.
rows.translation: Stláčajte končekmi prstov a prsty zaoblite do oblúka, aby sa žiadny neopieral o strunu pod ním. S krátkymi nechtami to ide oveľa ľahšie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pick the strings one at a time, thick to thin. A dull thud means a finger is touching that string. Adjust and pick it again.
rows.translation: Brnkajte na struny po jednej, od hrubej po tenkú. Tlmené buchnutie znamená, že sa struny dotýka prst. Upravte ho a brnknite znova.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: One string sounds dull. What's the likely cause?
rows.translation: Jedna struna znie tlmene. Čím to asi je?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A fingertip leaning on a neighboring string stops it ringing. Arch your fingers more.
rows.translation: Konček prsta opretý o susednú strunu jej bráni znieť. Prsty viac zaoblite.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Keep your E minor shape and add your first finger on string 3, fret 1. That one note turns minor into major.
rows.translation: Ponechajte hmat E mol a pridajte prvý prst na strunu 3, pražec 1. Tento jediný tón zmení molový akord na durový.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Major chords tend to sound bright and settled. Minor chords sound darker. E and E minor differ by just one note.
rows.translation: Durové akordy zvyčajne znejú jasne a ustálene. Molové znejú temnejšie. E a E mol sa líšia jediným tónom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A minor is the E shape moved one string thinner: fingers 2 and 3 on fret 2, finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: A mol je hmat E posunutý o strunu smerom k tenším strunám: prsty 2 a 3 na pražci 2, prst 1 na strune 2, pražci 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The root is the note a chord is named after. In A minor it's open string 5, so start your strum there and skip string 6.
rows.translation: Základný tón dáva akordu meno. V A mol je to prázdna struna 5, preto začnite úhoz na nej a strunu 6 vynechajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which string do you skip in A minor?
rows.translation: Ktorú strunu v A mol vynecháte?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A minor's root is open string 5. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: Základný tón A mol je na prázdnej strune 5. Tam začnite úhoz.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A packs fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2, on strings 4, 3 and 2. Strum from string 5.
rows.translation: Pri A sú prsty 1, 2 a 3 vedľa seba na pražci 2, na strunách 4, 3 a 2. Úhoz začnite na strune 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: If your fingers feel cramped, slant them so each sits just behind the fret at a slight angle. Keep string 1 clear so it rings.
rows.translation: Ak sa prsty tlačia, mierne ich nakloňte, aby každý sedel tesne pri pražci zo strany hlavy. Prstami na hmatníku netlmte strunu 1, aby mohla znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which fret holds all three fingers in A?
rows.translation: Na ktorom pražci sú všetky tri prsty v A?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From E minor to A minor
rows.translation: Z E mol do A mol
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Move the shape, not the fingers
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From E minor to A minor, fingers 2 and 3 hop together to strings 4 and 3. Then finger 1 lands on string 2. Your hand barely moves.
rows.translation: Z E mol do A mol presuňte prsty 2 a 3 spolu na struny 4 a 3. Potom položte prst 1 na strunu 2. Ruka sa takmer nepohne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Meňte včas, zahrajte na prvú dobu
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Strum once, then use the rest of the bar to change. Aim to land the new chord right on beat one. Speed comes later, by itself.
rows.translation: Zahrajte jeden úhoz a zvyšok taktu využite na zmenu. Nový akord má zaznieť presne na prvú dobu. Rýchlosť príde neskôr sama.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How should your fingers travel between chords?
rows.translation: Ako sa majú prsty presúvať medzi akordmi?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Moving the fingers as a unit is faster and lands cleaner. Keep them low, just above the strings.
rows.translation: Presun prstov ako celku je rýchlejší a hmat sadne čistejšie. Držte ich nízko, tesne nad strunami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Every finger moves from A to E. Picture the E shape before you lift, then move all three together. Aim finger 2 at string 5.
rows.translation: Z A do E sa presúva každý prst. Pred ich zdvihnutím si predstavte hmat E a potom presuňte všetky tri spolu. Prst 2 nasmerujte na strunu 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Song spotlight: Dust on the Dashboard
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Dust on the Dashboard is a Timbre Original: country in A. Every verse ends on two bars of E and two of A, the change you just learned. See the shape, move early and land on beat one. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Prach na palubnej doske je autorská pieseň Timbre: country v tónine A. Každá sloha sa končí dvoma taktmi E a dvoma A, teda práve naučenou zmenou. Predstavte si hmat, presuňte ho včas a zahrajte na prvú dobu. Celá pieseň je v časti Piesne pod Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Over E: open B, open E, D at fret 3 on string 2, C sharp at fret 2, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3.
rows.translation: Nad E: prázdne B a E, D na pražci 3 struny 2, C s krížikom na pražci 2 a G s krížikom na pražci 1 struny 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: E minor, E, A minor and A. Land each shape cleanly, then keep the changes steady.
rows.translation: Nič nové: E mol, E, A mol a A. Každý hmat zahrajte čisto a potom udržiavajte pravidelné zmeny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which finger turns E minor into E?
rows.translation: Ktorý prst zmení E mol na E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 3, fret 1 is the one note that makes E major.
rows.translation: Prst 1 na strune 3, pražci 1 hrá tón, ktorý vytvorí E dur.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Downstrokes, down-up eighths, accents and a strumming hand that never stops.
rows.translation: Úhozy nadol, osminové úhozy nadol-nahor, akcenty a neustály pohyb brnkajúcej ruky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Strum down on every beat and count out loud: one, two, three, four.
rows.translation: Štvrťová nota trvá jednu dobu. Na každú dobu zahrajte úhoz nadol a nahlas počítajte: raz, dva, tri, štyri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Let the motion come from a loose wrist and forearm, like shaking water off your hand. A stiff arm sounds harsh.
rows.translation: Pohyb nech vychádza z uvoľneného zápästia a predlaktia, akoby ste striasali vodu z ruky. So stuhnutou rukou znejú úhozy tvrdo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How many quarter-note strums fill a bar of four?
rows.translation: Koľko štvrťových úhozov tvorí štvordobý takt?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Split each beat in two. Strum down on the number and up on the and: one and two and. That's eight strums per bar.
rows.translation: Každú dobu rozdeľte na dve polovice. Na číslo brnknite nadol a na „a“ nahor: raz a dva a. To je osem brnknutí na takt.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Where does the up strum fall?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Down on the number, up on the and. Your hand goes down and up once per beat.
rows.translation: Na číslo nadol, na „a“ nahor. Ruka sa počas každej doby raz pohne nadol a nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Up strums are naturally softer. Brush just the thinner three or four strings on the way up. That gives the groove its lift.
rows.translation: Brnknutia nahor sú prirodzene tichšie. Pri pohybe nahor jemne prejdite iba cez tri alebo štyri tenšie struny. Rytmus tak získa ľahkosť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: An accent is a note played a little louder. Strum beat one harder than the rest. It tells everyone where the bar begins.
rows.translation: Akcent je tón zahraný o niečo hlasnejšie. Na prvú dobu brnknite silnejšie než na ostatné. Každý tak počuje, kde sa takt začína.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Beat one starts the bar. A slightly louder first strum keeps you, and anyone listening, in time.
rows.translation: Prvou dobou sa začína takt. O niečo hlasnejšie prvé brnknutie pomáha vám aj poslucháčom udržať sa v rytme.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Say the bar number on beat one: one, two, three, four; two, two, three, four. You always know where you are.
rows.translation: Na prvú dobu vyslovte číslo taktu: raz, dva, tri, štyri; dva, dva, tri, štyri. Vždy tak viete, kde ste.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your strumming hand swings down and up all the time, like a pendulum. To skip a strum, keep swinging and simply miss the strings.
rows.translation: Brnkajúca ruka sa neustále pohybuje nadol a nahor ako kyvadlo. Ak chcete brnknutie vynechať, pokračujte v pohybe, ale strún sa nedotknite.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: To skip a strum, your hand…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Keeps moving and misses the strings
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A hand that never stops keeps steady time. The skipped strum is a swing that doesn't touch the strings.
rows.translation: Ruka, ktorá sa nezastavuje, udržiava rovnomerný rytmus. Vynechané brnknutie je pohyb bez dotyku so strunami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: This pattern drives countless songs. On beat three your hand swings down without touching the strings, then catches the up strum.
rows.translation: Tento rytmus poháňa nespočetné piesne. Na tretiu dobu sa ruka pohne nadol bez dotyku so strunami a potom brnkne nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In this pattern, which beat has no strum on the number?
rows.translation: Na číslo ktorej doby sa v tomto rytme nebrnká?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On three the hand swings down past the strings, then strums up on the and.
rows.translation: Na tri sa ruka pohne nadol mimo strún a potom na „a“ brnkne nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Low Tide Radio is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae on E minor and A. The guitar plays only the ands. Keep your hand swinging down and up, miss the strings on each number and catch every and. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Rádio pri odlive je autorská pieseň Timbre: pohodové reggae na E mol a A. Gitara hrá iba na „a“. Ruku pohybujte nadol a nahor; na čísla struny vynechajte, na každé „a“ brnknite. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Where does the guitar play in Low Tide Radio?
rows.translation: Kedy hrá gitara v piesni Rádio pri odlive?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bass and drums hold the numbers. The guitar answers between them, on the ands.
rows.translation: Basgitara a bicie hrajú na čísla. Gitara odpovedá medzi nimi, na „a“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: quarters, eighths and the folk strum on the chords you know. Keep the hand swinging and lean on beat one.
rows.translation: Nič nové: štvrťové a osminové noty aj folkový rytmus na známych akordoch. Rukou stále pohybujte a zdôrazňujte prvú dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Down-up eighths: where are the up strums?
rows.translation: Osminy nadol a nahor: kedy sa brnká nahor?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Iba na druhú a štvrtú dobu
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C, G, D and D minor, two classic progressions, and the one-minute change.
rows.translation: C, G, D a D mol, dva klasické akordové sledy a minútové striedanie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C climbs like a staircase: finger 3 on string 5, fret 3; finger 2 on string 4, fret 2; finger 1 on string 2, fret 1.
rows.translation: C stúpa ako schodisko: prst 3 na strune 5, pražci 3; prst 2 na strune 4, pražci 2; prst 1 na strune 2, pražci 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which string do you skip in C?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Start the strum there.
rows.translation: Základný tón akordu C je na strune 5, pražci 3. Odtiaľ začnite brnkať.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A minor to C: one finger
rows.translation: Z A mol na C: jeden prst
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 2 stay exactly where they are. Only finger 3 moves, from string 3 to string 5, fret 3.
rows.translation: Prsty 1 a 2 zostanú presne na mieste. Pohne sa iba prst 3, zo struny 3 na strunu 5, pražec 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G spreads out: finger 2 on string 6, fret 3; finger 1 on string 5, fret 2; finger 3 on string 1, fret 3. All six strings ring.
rows.translation: Pri G sú prsty rozložené naširoko: prst 2 na strune 6, pražci 3; prst 1 na strune 5, pražci 2; prst 3 na strune 1, pražci 3. Znejú všetky struny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In G, which strings ring open?
rows.translation: Ktoré struny v G znejú prázdne?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: When you change, land the finger for the lowest string first. It's the first note your strum hits, which buys a moment for the rest.
rows.translation: Pri zmene akordu položte najprv prst na najnižšiu strunu. Brnknutie zasiahne tento tón ako prvý, takže získate chvíľu na ostatné prsty.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D lives on the thinnest three strings: finger 1 on string 3, fret 2; finger 3 on string 2, fret 3; finger 2 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: D leží na troch najtenších strunách: prst 1 na strune 3, pražci 2; prst 3 na strune 2, pražci 3; prst 2 na strune 1, pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Where does a D chord's strum start?
rows.translation: Na ktorej strune začínate brnkať akord D?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
rows.translation: Základným tónom akordu D je prázdna struna 4. Struny 5 a 6 zostávajú tiché.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: For D minor, the note on string 1 drops to fret 1. Reshuffle: finger 1 on string 1, finger 2 on string 3, finger 3 stays on string 2.
rows.translation: Pri D mol sa tón na strune 1 posunie na pražec 1. Zmeňte prstoklad: prst 1 na strunu 1, prst 2 na strunu 3, prst 3 zostáva na strune 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A key is a song's home base. In the key of G, the chords G, C and D do most of the work. Countless folk and rock songs use only these three.
rows.translation: Tónina je domovom piesne. V tónine G väčšinu práce odvedú akordy G, C a D. Nespočetné folkové aj rockové piesne používajú iba tieto tri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: You keep landing late on a change. What helps most?
rows.translation: Pri zmene akordu stále meškáte. Čo najviac pomôže?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Slow, early changes build the habit. Speed follows on its own.
rows.translation: Pomalými, včasnými zmenami si vytvoríte návyk. Rýchlosť príde sama.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A progression is a chord sequence that repeats. A minor, C, G, D starts dark and brightens as it climbs.
rows.translation: Akordový sled je opakujúca sa postupnosť akordov. A mol, C, G, D začína temne a pri stúpaní sa rozjasňuje.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Away from the app, pick two chords and switch for one minute, one strum each. Count your clean changes and beat that score tomorrow. Start with D and D minor.
rows.translation: Mimo aplikácie si vyberte dva akordy a minútu ich striedajte; na každý raz brnknite. Spočítajte čisté zmeny a zajtra svoj výsledok prekonajte. Začnite s D a D mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In a one-minute change, what do you count?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Kite Weather is a Timbre Original: bright campfire pop on G, D, E minor and C, around and around. Change early, and land the finger for the lowest string first. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Počasie na šarkany je autorská pieseň Timbre: jasný táborákový pop na G, D, E mol a C stále dookola. Akordy meňte včas a najprv položte prst na najnižšiu strunu. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which chord in Kite Weather skips strings 5 and 6?
rows.translation: Pri ktorom akorde v Počasí na šarkany vynecháte struny 5 a 6?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D's root is open string 4, so strings 5 and 6 stay quiet.
rows.translation: Základným tónom D je prázdna struna 4, preto struny 5 a 6 zostávajú tiché.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The verse adds A on string 3, fret 2: the note finger 1 holds in D. Open G, A, then open B.
rows.translation: Sloha pridáva A na strune 3, pražci 2: tón, ktorý v D drží prst 1. Prázdne G, A, potom prázdne B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: C, G, D and D minor join E minor, E, A minor and A. Change early, strum steady and let each chord ring.
rows.translation: Nič nové: C, G, D a D mol sa pridávajú k E mol, E, A mol a A. Akordy meňte včas, brnkajte rovnomerne a nechajte každý akord znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Pri ktorom akorde vynecháte struny 5 a 6?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Entire standardized chord symbol Am means A minor; preserve notation, not untranslated prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: G and A on string 3, D, E and F on string 4, the C major scale and two traditional tunes.
rows.translation: G a A na strune 3, D, E a F na strune 4, stupnica C dur a dve tradičné melódie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open string 3 is G. Put finger 2 on fret 2 and you get A. The same rule holds: the finger matches the fret.
rows.translation: Prázdna struna 3 znie ako G. Položte prst 2 na pražec 2 a získate A. Platí rovnaké pravidlo: číslo prsta zodpovedá pražcu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Brnknite na prázdnu strunu 3. To je G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G and A on string 3, then B, C and D on string 2.
rows.translation: G a A na strune 3, potom B, C a D na strune 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G up to D and back
rows.translation: Z G nahor na D a späť
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open string 4 is D. Fret 2 is E and fret 3 is F. Keep your thumb low behind the neck so your fingers can reach.
rows.translation: Prázdna struna 4 znie ako D. Na pražci 2 je E a na pražci 3 je F. Palec držte nízko za krkom, aby prsty dočiahli.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Brnknite na prázdnu strunu 4. To je D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fret 2, then fret 3: E, then F.
rows.translation: Pražec 2, potom pražec 3: E, potom F.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open string 4 and string 2, fret 3 share which name?
rows.translation: Aký názov má prázdna struna 4 aj struna 2 na pražci 3?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Both are D, an octave apart: the same note name, one higher than the other.
rows.translation: Oba tóny sú D, vzdialené o oktávu: majú rovnaký názov, ale jeden je vyšší než druhý.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D, E and F on string 4, then G and A on string 3.
rows.translation: D, E a F na strune 4, potom G a A na strune 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Put finger 3 on string 5, fret 3. That's C, the note the C major scale starts on.
rows.translation: Položte prst 3 na strunu 5, pražec 3. To je C, tón, ktorým sa začína stupnica C dur.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 5, fret 3, third finger. That's C.
rows.translation: Struna 5, pražec 3, tretí prst. To je C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A scale climbs note by note from one letter to the same letter an octave higher. C major uses only plain letter names: C D E F G A B C.
rows.translation: Stupnica stúpa tón po tóne od jedného písmena k tomu istému o oktávu vyššie. C dur používa iba základné názvy bez posuviek: C D E F G A B C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 5 fret 3, then strings 4, 3 and 2. Go slowly.
rows.translation: Struna 5, pražec 3, potom struny 4, 3 a 2. Hrajte pomaly.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How many different letter names are in C major?
rows.translation: Koľko rôznych písmenových názvov má C dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C D E F G A B, then C again an octave higher.
rows.translation: C D E F G A B, potom znova C o oktávu vyššie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: When the Saints Go Marching In
rows.translation: When the Saints Go Marching In
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Established external song title identifying the traditional work, not a generic instruction; surrounding instructional prose is translated. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: This traditional spiritual became a jazz standard. It uses C, D, E, F and G on strings 5, 4 and 3.
rows.translation: Tento tradičný spirituál sa stal džezovým štandardom. Používa C, D, E, F a G na strunách 5, 4 a 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The opening: C, E, F, then open G.
rows.translation: Začiatok: C, E, F, potom prázdne G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A pickup is a few notes that lead into a strong beat. Here beat one is silent, and C, E and F lead into a long G.
rows.translation: Predtakt tvorí niekoľko tónov vedúcich k ťažkej dobe. Tu je prvá doba tichá a C, E a F vedú k dlhému G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The chorus: E E D C, then C E G G G F.
rows.translation: Refrén: E E D C, potom C E G G G F.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Established external hymn title identifying the original work, rather than an invented translated work name. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Amazing Grace is in three: count one, two, three, with the weight on one. Its notes sit on strings 4, 3 and 2.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace je v trojdobom metre: počítajte raz, dva, tri s dôrazom na raz. Jej tóny ležia na strunách 4, 3 a 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How many beats are in each bar here?
rows.translation: Koľko dôb má každý takt v tejto skladbe?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A bar of three feels like a gentle sway: strong, weak, weak.
rows.translation: Trojdobý takt pripomína jemné kolísanie: ťažká, ľahká, ľahká.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The opening: D, G, B G, B, A. Open strings 4, 3 and 2, plus A.
rows.translation: Začiatok: D, G, B G, B, A. Prázdne struny 4, 3 a 2 a k nim A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Then down: G, E, D, D.
rows.translation: Potom nadol: G, E, D, D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The high part: open B up to D at fret 3, then down through B, G and A.
rows.translation: Vysoká časť: z prázdneho B na D na pražci 3, potom nadol cez B, G a A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Full credited personal name John Newton and original year 1779; no instructional prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Halogen is a Timbre Original: desert rock in D minor. Its riff uses the notes you just learned: open D, F at fret 3, open G, and C on string 5, fret 3. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Halogén je autorská pieseň Timbre: púštny rock v D mol. Riff používa práve naučené tóny: prázdne D, F na pražci 3, prázdne G a C na strune 5, pražci 3. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open string 4, F at fret 3, open string 3, then C at fret 3 on string 5.
rows.translation: Prázdna struna 4, F na pražci 3, prázdna struna 3, potom C na pražci 3 struny 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: every note from C on string 5 up to G on string 1, plus both tunes. Keep your thumb low and your fingers arched.
rows.translation: Nič nové: každý tón od C na strune 5 až po G na strune 1 aj obe melódie. Palec držte nízko a prsty zaoblené.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C major from string 5, up to G on string 1.
rows.translation: C dur zo struny 5 až po G na strune 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A mini F, D7, and two traditional songs with both chords and melody.
rows.translation: Malé F, D7 a dve tradičné piesne s akordmi aj melódiou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: This small F uses four strings. Finger 1 lies flat across strings 1 and 2 at fret 1, finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Toto malé F používa štyri struny. Prst 1 leží naplocho cez struny 1 a 2 na pražci 1, prst 2 je na strune 3, pražci 2 a prst 3 na strune 4, pražci 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Tilt finger 1 slightly onto its thumb side. The bonier edge presses two strings more easily. Check that string 2 rings.
rows.translation: Prst 1 mierne nakloňte na stranu bližšiu k palcu. Tvrdšia hrana ľahšie pritlačí dve struny. Skontrolujte, či struna 2 znie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: This progression climbs step by step from A minor and lands on your new F. Strum twice per chord and change early.
rows.translation: Tento sled stúpa krok za krokom z A mol až na vaše nové F. Na každý akord brnknite dvakrát a zmeny pripravujte včas.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Established proper title of the traditional English tune, not generic prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: This English tune is over 400 years old. Its chords are all ones you know: A minor, C, G, E minor, F and E. It's in three: strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Táto anglická melódia má vyše 400 rokov. Všetky jej akordy už poznáte: A mol, C, G, E mol, F a E. Je v trojdobom metre: brnkajte raz za takt, potom na každú dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which strings does the mini F leave silent?
rows.translation: Ktoré struny pri malom F neznejú?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The mini F starts on string 4. Begin your strum there and skip strings 5 and 6.
rows.translation: Malé F sa začína na strune 4. Odtiaľ začnite brnkať a struny 5 a 6 vynechajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A sharp raises a note by one fret. Greensleeves uses G sharp on string 3, fret 1, and F sharp on string 4, fret 4. Reach that one with your little finger.
rows.translation: Krížik zvýši tón o jeden pražec. Greensleeves používa Gis na strune 3, pražci 1 a Fis na strune 4, pražci 4. Na ten dočiahnite malíčkom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G sharp, A, B: string 3 at frets 1 and 2, then open string 2.
rows.translation: Gis, A, B: struna 3 na pražcoch 1 a 2, potom prázdna struna 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The opening: A, C D, E F E, D B.
rows.translation: Začiatok: A, C D, E F E, D B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Sharp means one fret higher. G sharp sits between G and A.
rows.translation: Krížik znamená o jeden pražec vyššie. Gis leží medzi G a A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The chorus starts high: G on string 1, fret 3, then F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Refrén začína vysoko: G na strune 1, pražci 3, potom Fis na pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A seventh chord adds a note that pulls toward home. D7 wants to move to G. Fingers: 2 on string 3, fret 2; 1 on string 2, fret 1; 3 on string 1, fret 2.
rows.translation: Septakord pridáva tón, ktorý nás ťahá domov. D7 chce prejsť do G. Prsty: 2 na strune 3, pražci 2; 1 na strune 2, pražci 1; 3 na strune 1, pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Proper title and personal name identifying the traditional American ballad. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: This American ballad from the 1880s needs only G and D7. It's in three, like Amazing Grace. Strum once per bar, then on every beat.
rows.translation: Táto americká balada z 1880. rokov potrebuje iba G a D7. Je v trojdobom metre ako Amazing Grace. Brnkajte raz za takt, potom na každú dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Clementine's melody sits on strings 4, 3 and 2. Its last line uses F sharp again: string 4, fret 4, little finger.
rows.translation: Melódia Clementine leží na strunách 4, 3 a 2. Posledný riadok znova používa Fis: struna 4, pražec 4, malíček.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The opening: G G G, down to open D, up to open B.
rows.translation: Začiatok: G G G, nadol na prázdne D, nahor na prázdne B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete chord symbol D7, matching the notation displayed by the app. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: D7's extra note leans toward G. When G arrives, the tension lets go.
rows.translation: Pridaný tón v D7 smeruje k G. Keď zaznie G, napätie sa uvoľní.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The last line: A, open D, F sharp at fret 4, A, then home to G.
rows.translation: Posledný riadok: A, prázdne D, Fis na pražci 4, A, potom domov na G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Full credited personal name Percy Montrose and original year 1884; no instructional prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Ghost Light is a Timbre Original: a slow, dark ballad. Its verse walks A minor, F, C and E, so your mini F gets a song, and the G sharp in E pulls the tune back home. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Svetlo duchov je autorská pieseň Timbre: pomalá, temná balada. Sloha prechádza cez A mol, F, C a E, takže malé F už zahráte v piesni. Gis v E ťahá melódiu späť domov. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Listen to the verse's last chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Vypočujte si posledný akord slohy. Je durový alebo molový?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The ballad strum: one big strum on beat one and let it ring, another on three, then down-up on four. The space after each strum is part of the song.
rows.translation: Baladický rytmus: silné brnknutie na prvú dobu nechajte doznieť, ďalšie na tretiu, potom nadol a nahor na štvrtú. Priestor po každom brnknutí je súčasťou piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The verse's last line: open B, C at fret 1, B, G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, B, then open E.
rows.translation: Posledný riadok slohy: prázdne B, C na pražci 1, B, Gis na pražci 1 struny 3, B, potom prázdne E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Dve piesne od začiatku do konca
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: the mini F, D7 and both songs from this unit. Change chords early and let the melodies sing.
rows.translation: Nič nové: malé F, D7 a obe piesne z tejto jednotky. Akordy meňte včas a nechajte melódie spievať.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest toward G?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord najsilnejšie smeruje k G?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: E7, A7, G7 and B7, sus chords, the shuffle and your first 12-bar blues.
rows.translation: E7, A7, G7 a B7, akordy sus, shuffle a vaše prvé 12-taktové blues.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play E, then lift finger 3 off string 4. The open D that rings is the seventh, a note that adds bluesy tension.
rows.translation: Zahrajte E a potom zdvihnite prst 3 zo struny 4. Zaznie prázdne D: septima, tón pridávajúci bluesové napätie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play A, then lift finger 2 off string 3. Open G rings, and A becomes A7.
rows.translation: Zahrajte A a potom zdvihnite prst 2 zo struny 3. Zaznie prázdne G a z A sa stane A7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How do you turn E into E7 here?
rows.translation: Ako tu zmeníte E na E7?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G7 keeps the low G but puts F on top: finger 3 on string 6, fret 3; finger 2 on string 5, fret 2; finger 1 on string 1, fret 1.

rows.source: Build B7 from string 5: finger 2 at fret 2, finger 1 on string 4, fret 1, finger 3 on string 3, fret 2, little finger on string 1, fret 2. String 2 rings open.
rows.translation: B7 postavte od struny 5: prst 2 na pražci 2, prst 1 na strune 4, pražci 1, prst 3 na strune 3, pražci 2, malíček na strune 1, pražci 2. Struna 2 znie prázdna.

rows.source: Which chord does B7 lead to most naturally?
rows.translation: Ku ktorému akordu najprirodzenejšie vedie B7?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B7 pulls toward E. Its tension melts into E minor or E.
rows.translation: B7 smeruje k E. Jeho napätie sa uvoľní v E mol alebo E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A shuffle splits each beat unevenly: a long strum down, a short one up. It's the heartbeat of the blues. Think hum-pty, dum-pty.
rows.translation: Shuffle delí každú dobu nerovnomerne: dlhé brnknutie nadol, krátke nahor. Je to pulz blues. Predstavte si „dáá-da, dáá-da“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In a shuffle, each beat splits into…
rows.translation: V rytme shuffle sa každá doba delí na…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Many blues songs follow one 12-bar plan. In E: four bars of E7, two of A7, two of E7, then one each of B7, A7, E7 and B7.
rows.translation: Mnohé bluesové piesne majú rovnaký 12-taktový plán. V E: štyri takty E7, dva A7, dva E7 a potom po jednom takte B7, A7, E7 a B7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How many bars of E7 open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Koľkými taktmi E7 sa začína 12-taktové blues?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The last four bars move faster: B7, A7, E7, then B7, which turns you around to the top. Change early and keep the shuffle going.
rows.translation: Posledné štyri takty sa menia rýchlejšie: B7, A7, E7 a potom B7, ktoré vás vrátia na začiatok. Akordy meňte včas a udržujte shuffle.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A sus chord swaps the note that makes it major or minor for a neighbor. It sounds open and unresolved until it settles home.
rows.translation: Akord sus nahrádza tón určujúci dur alebo mol susedným tónom. Znie otvorene a nevyriešene, kým sa neusadí doma.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Lift finger 2 off string 1 to get Dsus2. For Asus4, play A and add your little finger on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Zdvihnite prst 2 zo struny 1 a získate Dsus2. Pre Asus4 zahrajte A a pridajte malíček na strunu 2, pražec 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Rust Belt Shuffle is a Timbre Original: a 12-bar blues in E, the plan you just strummed, with a swung tune on top. Keep the long-short feel in both hands. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Shuffle hrdzavého pásu je autorská pieseň Timbre: 12-taktové blues v E podľa práve hraného plánu, nad ktorým znie swingová melódia. V oboch rukách držte rytmus dlho-krátko. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open G, then G sharp at fret 1 on string 3, then open B: the bluesy slide in bar two.
rows.translation: Prázdne G, potom Gis na pražci 1 struny 3 a prázdne B: bluesový sklz v druhom takte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bar two slides from G to G sharp. Which one belongs to E7?
rows.translation: V druhom takte je sklz z G na Gis. Ktorý z nich patrí do E7?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: E7 is E, G sharp, B and D. G is the blue note: it rubs against the chord, then slides into it.
rows.translation: E7 tvoria E, Gis, B a D. G je bluesový tón: vytvára napätie voči akordu a potom doň skĺzne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bar nine, over B7: F sharp at fret 2 on string 1, open E, D sharp at fret 4 on string 2 with your little finger, then B.
rows.translation: Deviaty takt, nad B7: Fis na pražci 2 struny 1, prázdne E, Dis na pražci 4 struny 2 malíčkom, potom B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: seventh chords, sus chords and the 12-bar shuffle. Keep the long-short swing steady through every change.
rows.translation: Nič nové: septakordy, akordy sus a 12-taktový shuffle. Pri každej zmene zachovajte rovnomerný swing dlho-krátko.

rows.translation: Kvintové akordy s prázdnymi strunami aj posuvné hmaty, tlmenie dlaňou a vlastný riff.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A power chord plays only the root and the fifth, the note five letters up. Neither major nor minor, it stays punchy, even loud. E5 is the bottom of E minor.
rows.translation: Kvintový akord obsahuje iba základný tón a kvintu, tón o päť písmen vyššie. Nie je durový ani molový a znie úderne aj nahlas. E5 tvorí spodná časť E mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Move the same two fingers to strings 4 and 3. With open string 5, that's A5. Aim your strum at strings 5, 4 and 3 only.
rows.translation: Tie isté dva prsty presuňte na struny 4 a 3. S prázdnou strunou 5 tak vznikne A5. Brnkajte iba cez struny 5, 4 a 3.

rows.source: Lay the outer edge of your picking hand on the strings, right where they meet the bridge. Strum, and the notes turn short and chunky.
rows.translation: Vonkajšiu hranu brnkajúcej ruky položte na struny tesne pri kobylke. Brnknite a tóny budú krátke a hutné.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Where does your palm rest for palm muting?
rows.translation: Kde spočíva dlaň pri tlmení dlaňou?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: At the bridge the strings still sound, just shorter. Move forward and they go dead.
rows.translation: Pri kobylke struny stále znejú, iba kratšie. Posuňte dlaň smerom ku krku a úplne ich stlmíte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Rock often builds with muted eighths, then lands on an open chord. Lift your palm for the big strum and let it ring.
rows.translation: Rock často buduje napätie tlmenými osminami a potom nechá akord voľne zaznieť. Pri silnom brnknutí zdvihnite dlaň a nechajte ho znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Finger 1 on string 6, fret 3, then fingers 3 and 4 two frets higher on strings 5 and 4. That's G5. Slide it and the name follows the fret.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položte na strunu 6, pražec 3, potom prsty 3 a 4 o dva pražce vyššie na struny 5 a 4. To je G5. Posúvajte hmat a názov sa mení podľa pražca.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your root is on string 6, fret 5. Which power chord is it?
rows.translation: Základný tón je na strune 6, pražci 5. Ktorý kvintový akord to je?

rows.source: Count up string 6: E open, F at 1, G at 3, A at 5.
rows.translation: Postupujte po strune 6: prázdne E, F na 1, G na 3, A na 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The same shape works from string 5. Finger 1 on string 5, fret 3 gives C5. Let the tip of finger 1 touch string 6 to keep it quiet.
rows.translation: Rovnaký hmat funguje aj od struny 5. Prst 1 na strune 5, pražci 3 dáva C5. Koncom prsta 1 sa dotknite struny 6, aby nezaznela.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A riff is a short, catchy phrase that repeats. This one bounces off open low E. Rest your palm at the bridge to keep it tight.
rows.translation: Riff je krátka, chytľavá fráza, ktorá sa opakuje. Tento sa odráža od prázdneho hlbokého E. Dlaň oprite pri kobylke, aby znel pevne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open E, string 6 at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: Prázdne E, struna 6 na pražci 3, potom prázdne A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The second bar climbs string 5: fret 2, then fret 5 with your little finger, then back to fret 2. Keep finger 1 parked near fret 2.
rows.translation: Druhý takt stúpa po strune 5: pražec 2, potom pražec 5 malíčkom a späť na pražec 2. Prst 1 nechajte pri pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 5: fret 2, fret 5 with your little finger, fret 2 again.
rows.translation: Struna 5: pražec 2, pražec 5 malíčkom, znova pražec 2.

rows.source: Songs often answer a riff with power chords. Play the riff, then hit the chords on one, the and of two, and four.

rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Slide G5 up two frets. What do you get?
rows.translation: Posuňte G5 o dva pražce vyššie. Čo získate?

rows.translation: O dva pražce nad G je A. Názov akordu sa posúva spolu so základným tónom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Basement Weather is a Timbre Original: garage rock in A. A riff on the low strings opens it, then power chords punch back on one, the and of two, and four. Keep your palm at the bridge. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Počasie v pivnici je autorská pieseň Timbre: garážový rock v A. Začne riffom na hlbokých strunách a kvintové akordy odpovedia na prvú dobu, na „a“ druhej a na štvrtú. Dlaň držte pri kobylke. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open A, C at fret 3 on string 5, open D, then G at fret 3 on string 6 and open low E.
rows.translation: Prázdne A, C na pražci 3 struny 5, prázdne D, potom G na pražci 3 struny 6 a prázdne hlboké E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: You know C5, with finger 1 on string 5, fret 3. Slide the whole shape up two frets and it becomes D5. G5 sits at fret 3 too, one string lower than C5.
rows.translation: Poznáte C5 s prstom 1 na strune 5, pražci 3. Posuňte celý hmat o dva pražce vyššie a vznikne D5. G5 je tiež na pražci 3, o strunu nižšie než C5.

rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Struna 5 stúpa od A: B na 2, C na 3.

rows.source: Which one is a power chord?
rows.translation: Ktorý z nich je kvintový akord?

rows.source: The F barre and B minor, the A minor pentatonic scale and your first solo.
rows.translation: F s barré a B mol, pentatonická stupnica A mol a vaše prvé sólo.

rows.source: Full barre chords take weeks, so build up to them. You know the mini F. Next comes a five-string F, then the full barre.
rows.translation: Úplné barré akordy sa učia celé týždne, preto postupujte po krokoch. Malé F už poznáte. Nasleduje F na piatich strunách a potom úplné barré.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Move finger 3 to string 5, fret 3, and put your little finger on string 4, fret 3. Five strings ring and the F sounds fuller.
rows.translation: Presuňte prst 3 na strunu 5, pražec 3 a položte malíček na strunu 4, pražec 3. Zaznie päť strún a F bude plnšie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Barre chords feel hard at first. What helps most?
rows.translation: Barré akordy sú spočiatku ťažké. Čo najviac pomôže?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Squeezing as hard as you can
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Strength and feel build slowly. Short, daily practice beats one long, painful session.
rows.translation: Sila a cit sa budujú postupne. Krátke každodenné cvičenie je lepšie než jedno dlhé a bolestivé.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Lay finger 1 flat across all six strings at fret 1. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 make an E shape in front of it. F is E moved up one fret.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položte naplocho cez všetkých šesť strún na pražci 1. Prsty 2, 3 a 4 pred ním vytvoria hmat E. F je E posunuté o jeden pražec vyššie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Let your arm's weight pull the barre in, as if gently drawing the neck toward you. Your thumb only steadies. Roll finger 1 onto its side.
rows.translation: Nechajte váhu ruky pritiahnuť barré, akoby ste krk jemne ťahali k sebe. Palec iba stabilizuje. Prst 1 pootočte na bok.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The F barre is which open shape, moved up a fret?
rows.translation: Ktorý otvorený hmat posunutý o pražec vyššie tvorí F s barré?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Finger 1 barres strings 1 to 5 at fret 2. Fingers 2, 3 and 4 build an A minor shape two frets higher. Skip string 6.
rows.translation: Prst 1 tvorí barré cez struny 1 až 5 na pražci 2. Prsty 2, 3 a 4 vytvoria hmat A mol posunutý o dva pražce vyššie. Strunu 6 vynechajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Not ready to barre? Play the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1.
rows.translation: Na barré ešte nie ste pripravení? Hrajte iba štyri najvyššie struny: pražec 4 na strunách 4 a 3, pražec 3 na strune 2 a pražec 2 na strune 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which chord is E moved up one fret with a barre?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord vznikne posunutím E o pražec vyššie s barré?

rows.source: The minor pentatonic scale has five notes. In A minor they're A, C, D, E and G. It's the sound of countless blues and rock solos.
rows.translation: Molová pentatonická stupnica má päť tónov. V A mol sú to A, C, D, E a G. Takto znie nespočetné množstvo bluesových a rockových sól.

rows.source: Finger 1 covers fret 5 on every string. Fingers 3 and 4 take frets 7 and 8. Two notes per string, one finger per fret.
rows.translation: Prst 1 pokrýva pražec 5 na každej strune. Prsty 3 a 4 hrajú na pražcoch 7 a 8. Dva tóny na strunu, jeden prst na pražec.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fret 5, fret 8 on string 6, then fret 5, fret 7 on string 5.

rows.source: A solo is a melody built from short phrases. Play a few notes, leave a gap, then answer. Ending on A, the root, sounds like a full stop.
rows.translation: Sólo je melódia z krátkych fráz. Zahrajte pár tónov, nechajte medzeru a potom odpovedzte. Záver na základnom tóne A znie ako bodka za vetou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which note sounds most like a full stop in A minor?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón v A mol znie najviac ako bodka za vetou?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A is the root, the home of A minor. Ending a phrase on it sounds finished.
rows.translation: A je základný tón, domov A mol. Fráza zakončená na ňom znie uzavreto.

rows.source: A power ballad with a barre
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Glass Satellites is a Timbre Original: a power ballad on A minor, F, C and G. Your full F barre takes the second chord, and box 1 fits over the whole loop, so it gets a solo. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Sklenené satelity sú autorská pieseň Timbre: rocková balada na A mol, F, C a G. Druhým akordom je vaše úplné F s barré. Box 1 sedí na celý sled, takže dostane sólo. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Over the F chord, which box-1 notes belong to it?
rows.translation: Ktoré tóny boxu 1 patria do akordu F?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: F is F, A and C. Box 1 holds A and C, so they sound settled over F.
rows.translation: F tvoria F, A a C. Box 1 obsahuje A a C, preto nad F znejú ustálene.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: barre chords, B minor, the pentatonic box and your solo. Breathe, keep the beat, and play it like you mean it.
rows.translation: Nič nové: barré akordy, B mol, pentatonický box a vaše sólo. Dýchajte, držte rytmus a hrajte s presvedčením.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which finger covers fret 5 in box 1?
rows.translation: Ktorý prst pokrýva pražec 5 v boxe 1?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Thumb on the bass, p-i-m-a, Travis picking and a fingerpicked ballad.
rows.translation: Palec na basoch, p-i-m-a, Travisovo vybrnkávanie a balada hraná prstami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fingerpicking means plucking with your fingers instead of a pick. Your thumb owns the bass strings, 6, 5 and 4, and plays on the beat like a bass drum.
rows.translation: Pri vybrnkávaní hráte prstami namiesto trsátka. Palcu patria basové struny 6, 5 a 4 a hrá na doby ako veľký bubon.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Thumb only: push down through strings 6, 5 and 4, one at a time.
rows.translation: Iba palec: postupne brnknite nadol cez struny 6, 5 a 4, vždy po jednej.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which strings does your thumb usually play?
rows.translation: Na ktorých strunách zvyčajne hrá palec?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The thumb takes the bass strings. Your fingers take the thinner ones.
rows.translation: Palec hrá na basových strunách. Ostatné prsty na tenších.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Hold A minor. Your thumb plays the root on string 5, then rocks over to string 4, the chord's fifth. Root, fifth, root, fifth: that's an alternating bass.
rows.translation: Držte A mol. Palec hrá základný tón na strune 5 a potom prejde na strunu 4, kvintu akordu. Základný tón, kvinta, základný tón, kvinta: to je striedavý bas.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Z E mol na A mol
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fingerstyle borrows Spanish names: p for the thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. Rest i on string 3, m on string 2 and a on string 1, ready to pluck.
rows.translation: Pri hre prstami sa používajú španielske označenia: p je palec, i ukazovák, m prostredník, a prstenník. Pripravte i na strunu 3, m na strunu 2 a a na strunu 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: i, m, a: index on string 3, middle on 2, ring on 1.
rows.translation: i, m, a: ukazovák na strune 3, prostredník na 2, prstenník na 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: p thumb, i index, m middle, a ring. The little finger usually rests.
rows.translation: p palec, i ukazovák, m prostredník, a prstenník. Malíček zvyčajne odpočíva.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Each finger plucks up and slightly toward your palm, then relaxes. Keep your hand still above the strings and let the fingers do the moving.
rows.translation: Každý prst brnkne nahor a mierne smerom do dlane, potom sa uvoľní. Ruku držte nehybne nad strunami a pohyb nechajte na prsty.

rows.source: Travis picking, named after Merle Travis, keeps the thumb alternating on every beat while the fingers pluck in between, on the ands.
rows.translation: Travisovo vybrnkávanie, pomenované po Merlovi Travisovi, strieda basy palcom na každú dobu, zatiaľ čo prsty brnkajú medzi nimi, na „a“.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In Travis picking, what does the thumb do?
rows.translation: Čo robí palec pri Travisovom vybrnkávaní?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Alternates bass notes on every beat
rows.translation: Strieda basové tóny na každú dobu

rows.source: The thumb is the steady pulse: a bass note on every beat, rocking between two strings.
rows.translation: Palec drží pravidelný pulz: basový tón na každú dobu, striedavo na dvoch strunách.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Keep the thumb going. Between thumb notes, m plucks string 2 and i plucks string 3: thumb, m, thumb, i. Go slowly until it runs by itself.
rows.translation: Palec nechajte hrať. Medzi jeho tónmi brnká m na strunu 2 a i na strunu 3: palec, m, palec, i. Hrajte pomaly, kým sa pohyb nezautomatizuje.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 2?
rows.translation: Ktorý prst brnká na strunu 2 medzi tónmi palca?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI

rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
