rows.source: In this pattern m takes string 2 and i takes string 3. The a finger rests for now.
rows.translation: V tomto vzore hrá m na strune 2 a i na strune 3. Prst a zatiaľ odpočíva.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: When the chord changes, the thumb lands on the new root right on beat one. The fingers keep plucking strings 2 and 3 as before.
rows.translation: Pri zmene akordu palec zahrá nový základný tón presne na prvú dobu. Ostatné prsty ďalej brnkajú na strunách 2 a 3 ako predtým.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The chord changes. Where does your thumb go?
rows.translation: Akord sa mení. Kam ide palec?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The bass tells the ear which chord you're on. Landing the root on beat one makes the change clear.
rows.translation: Basový tón uchu oznámi, ktorý akord hráte. Základný tón na prvú dobu zmenu jasne vyjadrí.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Hold each chord for the whole bar so every note rings into the next. Lift a finger only when the next shape needs it.
rows.translation: Každý akord držte celý takt, aby tóny doznievali jeden do druhého. Prst zdvihnite, až keď to vyžaduje ďalší hmat.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: An arpeggio plays a chord one note at a time. This one rolls p, i, m, a, then back down m, i. Six notes fill a bar of three, two to a beat.
rows.translation: Arpeggio hrá akord po jednotlivých tónoch. Tu prsty postupujú p, i, m, a, potom späť m, i. Šesť tónov vyplní trojdobý takt, po dva na dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: After a plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Ktorý prst nasleduje po tom, čo a brnkne na strunu 1?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete standard classical-guitar finger notation p, not prose or an article. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: p, i, m, a, then m and i on the way back.
rows.translation: Na vrchu sa smer obráti: p, i, m, a, potom späť m a i.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: One bar each: A minor, F, C, G, then A minor, F, E, A minor. Your thumb finds each new root: strings 5, 4, 5 and 6.
rows.translation: Po jednom takte: A mol, F, C, G, potom A mol, F, E, A mol. Palec nájde každý nový základný tón: struny 5, 4, 5 a 6.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Porchlight is a Timbre Original: a slow ballad in D. Fingerpick it: your thumb on each chord's root, then i, m and a up strings 3, 2 and 1. Let every note ring into the next. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Svetlo na verande je autorská pieseň Timbre: pomalá balada v D. Vybrnkávajte ju: palec na základnom tóne akordu, potom i, m a a cez struny 3, 2 a 1. Nechajte tóny doznievať jeden do druhého. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In D, which string does your thumb play?
rows.translation: Na ktorej strune hrá palec pri D?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D's root is open string 4. Strings 5 and 6 stay quiet in this chord.
rows.translation: Základným tónom D je prázdna struna 4. Struny 5 a 6 pri tomto akorde neznejú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: the alternating bass, p-i-m-a, Travis picking and the ballad. Keep the thumb steady and let every note ring.
rows.translation: Nič nové: striedavý bas, p-i-m-a, Travisovo vybrnkávanie a balada. Palec nech drží rytmus a každý tón nechajte znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In p-i-m-a, which letter is the thumb?
rows.translation: Ktoré písmeno v p-i-m-a označuje palec?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Between thumb notes, which finger plucks string 3?
rows.translation: Ktorý prst brnká na strunu 3 medzi tónmi palca?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Whole musical genre name Blues is used in Slovak; no English instruction or generic untranslated prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: The 12-bar in A, the quick change, a boogie bass line, the turnaround and your first blues licks.
rows.translation: 12-taktové blues v A, skorá zmena akordu, basová linka boogie, návratový motív a prvé bluesové frázy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
rows.translation: Bluesové akordy stoja na prvom, štvrtom a piatom tóne tóniny. V E sú to E7, A7 a B7. V tónine A sa z nich stanú A7, D7 a E7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In the key of A, which chord does the job B7 did in E?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord má v tónine A rovnakú úlohu ako B7 v E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete standardized chord symbol G7, matching displayed pitch and chord notation; no untranslated prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: B7 is five letters up from E. Five letters up from A is E, so E7 takes its place.
rows.translation: B7 leží o päť písmen vyššie od E. O päť písmen vyššie od A je E, preto jeho miesto zaujme E7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Four bars of A7, two of D7, two of A7, then one each of E7, D7, A7 and E7. The last E7 turns you back to the top.
rows.translation: Štyri takty A7, dva D7, dva A7 a potom po jednom takte E7, D7, A7 a E7. Posledné E7 vás vráti na začiatok.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In a quick change, bar 2 jumps to the four chord and straight back. In A: A7, D7, A7, A7. It adds motion right from the start.
rows.translation: Pri skorej zmene akordu sa v takte 2 preskočí na štvrtý stupeň a hneď späť. V A: A7, D7, A7, A7. Pohyb tak vzniká už od začiatku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In a quick change in A, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je v takte 2 pri skorej zmene v A?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The four chord in A is D7. The quick change visits it in bar 2, then returns to A7.
rows.translation: Akordom na štvrtom stupni v A je D7. Skorá zmena ho použije v takte 2 a potom sa vráti k A7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The quick change works in any key. In E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Watch for B7 near the end, your four-finger chord.
rows.translation: Skorá zmena funguje v každej tónine. V E: E7, A7, E7, E7. Pri závere si všimnite B7, váš akord so štyrmi prstami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A boogie line walks up the chord and back, each note twice, long-short like the shuffle. Over A7 it climbs A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, then walks back down.
rows.translation: Linka boogie kráča nahor po tónoch akordu a späť, každý tón dvakrát, dlho-krátko ako shuffle. Nad A7 stúpa cez A, Cis, E, Fis, G a potom sa vracia nadol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open A, fret 4 on string 5, frets 2 and 4 on string 4, then open G.
rows.translation: Prázdne A, pražec 4 na strune 5, pražce 2 a 4 na strune 4, potom prázdne G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How do the two notes of each pair feel?
rows.translation: Ako znejú dva tóny každej dvojice?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: It's the shuffle again: a long note on the beat, a short one just before the next.
rows.translation: Je to opäť shuffle: dlhý tón na dobu, krátky tesne pred nasledujúcou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Move it to D and E
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The same walk starts from D on string 4 and from E on string 6. Over D7: D, F sharp, A, B, C. Over E7: E, G sharp, B, C sharp, D.
rows.translation: Rovnaký postup začína od D na strune 4 a od E na strune 6. Nad D7: D, Fis, A, B, C. Nad E7: E, Gis, B, Cis, D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Boogie, A to D and back
rows.translation: Boogie z A do D a späť
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A lick that turns you around
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bars 11 and 12 often get a turnaround, a short lick that leads back to the top. This one walks down from A to E, one fret at a time.
rows.translation: Takty 11 a 12 často obsahujú návratový motív, krátku frázu vedúcu späť na začiatok. Táto klesá z A do E po jednom pražci.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 4: fret 4, then 3, then 2. Let the E ring.
rows.translation: Struna 4: pražec 4, potom 3 a potom 2. E nechajte znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Where does a turnaround usually go?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The last two bars. It leads the ear back to bar 1 for another time around.
rows.translation: Do posledných dvoch taktov. Vedie ucho späť k taktu 1, aby sa celý sled zopakoval.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Strum the first ten bars with the quick change, then switch to the lick for bars 11 and 12. That's how a blues band ends each time around.
rows.translation: Prvých desať taktov brnkajte so skorou zmenou, potom v taktoch 11 a 12 prejdite na frázu. Takto bluesová kapela končí každé opakovanie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your A minor pentatonic box fits right over a blues in A. Its C rubs against the C sharp in A7, and that rub is the sound of the blues.
rows.translation: Váš box pentatoniky A mol sa hodí k blues v A. Jeho C vytvára napätie voči Cis v A7 a práve toto trenie tvorí zvuk blues.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Over a blues in A, which note sounds most like home?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón nad blues v A znie najviac ako domov?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A is the root of the key. Licks that end on A sound settled; G and C leave you hanging.
rows.translation: A je základný tón tóniny. Frázy končiace na A znejú ustálene; G a C ponechávajú napätie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Blues phrases talk to each other. Play lick 1 as the question, then answer with lick 2, which lands on the low A.
rows.translation: Bluesové frázy sa spolu rozprávajú. Zahrajte frázu 1 ako otázku a odpovedzte frázou 2, ktorá končí na hlbokom A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Neon Laundromat is a Timbre Original: funk that sits on one chord, A7. Its hook slides from C to C sharp, the same rub your blues licks make, and its chorus drops to E7. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Neónová práčovňa je autorská pieseň Timbre: funk postavený na jedinom akorde A7. Hlavný motív kĺže z C na Cis, čím vytvára rovnaké napätie ako bluesové frázy, a refrén klesne k E7. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A at fret 2 on string 3, then C and C sharp at frets 1 and 2 on string 2, then open E.
rows.translation: A na pražci 2 struny 3, potom C a Cis na pražcoch 1 a 2 struny 2, potom prázdne E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Over A7, which note rubs against the chord?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón vytvára napätie voči akordu A7?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A7 is A, C sharp, E and G. C, from your pentatonic box, rubs against its C sharp, and the hook slides from one to the other.
rows.translation: A7 tvoria A, Cis, E a G. C z vášho pentatonického boxu vytvára napätie voči jeho Cis a hlavný motív kĺže medzi nimi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Neon Laundromat doesn't shuffle. Play your boogie walk in even eighths and it becomes a bass line under the A7: A, C sharp, E, F sharp, G, and back down.
rows.translation: Neónová práčovňa nepoužíva shuffle. Hrajte boogie postup rovnými osminami a vznikne basová linka pod A7: A, Cis, E, Fis, G a späť nadol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: the 12-bar in A and E, the quick change, the boogie line, the turnaround and your licks. Keep the shuffle swinging.
rows.translation: Nič nové: 12-taktové blues v A a E, skorá zmena, linka boogie, návratový motív a vaše frázy. Udržujte swingový rytmus shuffle.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In a quick change in E, which chord is bar 2?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je v takte 2 pri skorej zmene v E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bends and vibrato, and a second pentatonic box.
rows.translation: Príklepy, odtrhy, sklzy, vyťahovanie strún, vibrato a druhý pentatonický box.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A hammer-on sounds a second note with the fretting hand alone. Pick a note, then bring another finger down hard, just behind a higher fret. The string keeps ringing.
rows.translation: Príklepom rozozvučíte druhý tón iba rukou na hmatníku. Brnknite a potom rýchlo pritlačte ďalší prst tesne pri vyššom pražci zo strany hlavy. Struna znie ďalej.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pick open string 3, then hammer finger 2 onto fret 2. Don't pick the second note.
rows.translation: Brnknite na prázdnu strunu 3 a priklepnite prst 2 na pražec 2. Na druhý tón už nebrnkajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 3: pick fret 5 with finger 1, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 7.
rows.translation: Struna 3: brnknite na pražci 5 s prstom 1, potom priklepnite prst 3 na pražec 7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: What makes a hammer-on ring clearly?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A fast, firm landing right behind the fret
rows.translation: Rýchly pevný príklep tesne pri pražci
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Speed and aim matter more than force. Land on the fingertip, right behind the fret, and the string keeps singing.
rows.translation: Rýchlosť a presnosť sú dôležitejšie než sila. Dopadnite končekom prsta tesne pri pražci zo strany hlavy a struna bude znieť ďalej.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A pull-off drops to a lower note. With both fingers down, pick the higher note, then flick the top finger off sideways so it plucks the string as it leaves.
rows.translation: Odtrh prejde na nižší tón. Položte oba prsty, brnknite na vyšší tón a potom horný prst odtiahnite do strany tak, aby pri odchode brnkol na strunu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3, then flick finger 2 off to sound open G.
rows.translation: Pražec 2 na strune 3, potom odtrhnite prst 2, aby zaznelo prázdne G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 3 on frets 5 and 7. Pick, then pull finger 3 off.
rows.translation: Prsty 1 a 3 na pražcoch 5 a 7. Brnknite, potom odtrhnite prst 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In a pull-off, the top finger…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Flicks off sideways, plucking the string
rows.translation: Odtiahne sa do strany a brnkne na strunu
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Lifting straight up lets the note die. A small sideways flick plucks the lower note into life.
rows.translation: Pri zdvihnutí priamo nahor tón zanikne. Malý pohyb do strany rozozvučí nižší tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: To slide, pick a note and keep pressing as you glide the same finger to a new fret. The pressure carries the sound; only the first note is picked.
rows.translation: Pri sklze brnknite na tón a za stáleho tlaku posuňte ten istý prst na nový pražec. Tlak udržuje zvuk; brnká sa iba na prvý tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 7. Pick, then slide up to fret 9 without lifting.
rows.translation: Prst 3 na strune 3, pražci 7. Brnknite a bez zdvihnutia skĺznite na pražec 9.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: During a slide, what keeps the note sounding?
rows.translation: Čo pri sklze udržiava znenie tónu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Ease off and the note dies. Keep the same pressure all the way to the new fret.
rows.translation: Keď tlak uvoľníte, tón zanikne. Až po nový pražec udržujte rovnaký tlak.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now back: pick fret 9 and slide down to fret 7.
rows.translation: Teraz späť: brnknite na pražci 9 a skĺznite na pražec 7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.
rows.translation: Pri vyťahovaní tlačíte strunu naprieč pražcom a zvyšujete jej tón. Celotónové vytiahnutie, veľké ako dva pražce, z pražca 7 musí znieť presne ako pražec 9.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.
rows.translation: Struna 3, pražec 9: cieľový tón vytiahnutia. Nechajte ho znieť a zapamätajte si ho.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.
rows.translation: Prst 3 položte na pražec 7 a prsty 1 a 2 zaň na tú istú strunu. Všetkými tromi tlačte k stropu a otáčajte zápästím, akoby ste otáčali guľou na dverách.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?
rows.translation: Vytiahnutie z pražca 7 znie nižšie než pražec 9. Čo teraz?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A bend that falls short sounds sour. Push until it matches the target you heard.
rows.translation: Nedotiahnutý tón znie falošne. Tlačte, kým sa nezhoduje s cieľovým tónom, ktorý ste počuli.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Target, then a short bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: Cieľový tón, potom nedotiahnutý tón. Rovnaké alebo odlišné?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Vibrato is a small bend and release, repeated quickly on a held note. Keep it narrow and even so the note stays in tune.
rows.translation: Vibrato je drobné vytiahnutie a uvoľnenie struny, rýchlo opakované na držanom tóne. Udržujte ho úzke a rovnomerné, aby tón zostal naladený.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The same five notes repeat up the neck. Box 2 starts where box 1 ends: finger 1 at fret 7 on strings 5, 4 and 3, finger 2 at fret 8 on strings 6, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Tých istých päť tónov sa opakuje vyššie na krku. Box 2 začína tam, kde box 1 končí: prst 1 na pražci 7 strún 5, 4 a 3, prst 2 na pražci 8 strún 6, 2 a 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 6: frets 8 and 10. String 5: frets 7 and 10.
rows.translation: Struna 6: pražce 8 a 10. Struna 5: pražce 7 a 10.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The same five notes as box 1, A C D E G, in a new place on the neck.
rows.translation: Rovnakých päť tónov ako v boxe 1, A C D E G, na novom mieste na krku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: To travel from box 1 to box 2, slide finger 3 from fret 7 to fret 9 on string 3. You arrive in box 2 with your hand already in place.
rows.translation: Z boxu 1 do boxu 2 prejdete sklzom prsta 3 z pražca 7 na pražec 9 na strune 3. V boxe 2 už bude vaša ruka na správnom mieste.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Slaná nedeľa je autorská pieseň Timbre: pohodové reggae v A mol, kde sa po taktoch striedajú Am7 a D7. Hodia sa k nim oba pentatonické boxy. Hrajte príklepy, odtrhy aj sklzy a každý takt začnite akordovým tónom. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Over D7, which of these box notes belongs to the chord?
rows.translation: Ktorý z týchto tónov boxu patrí do akordu D7?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D7 is D, F sharp, A and C. C, its seventh, sounds settled; E and G only pass through.
rows.translation: D7 tvoria D, Fis, A a C. Jeho septima C znie ustálene; E a G sú iba priechodné tóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your break over Am7 and D7
rows.translation: Vaša sólová časť nad Am7 a D7
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bend targets, vibrato and both boxes. Play each phrase cleanly, then make it sing.
rows.translation: Nič nové: príklepy, odtrhy, sklzy, cieľové tóny vyťahovania, vibrato a oba boxy. Každú frázu zahrajte čisto a potom ju rozospievajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A whole-step bend from fret 7 should match…
rows.translation: Celotónové vytiahnutie z pražca 7 má znieť ako…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Target, then a bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: Cieľový tón, potom vytiahnutý tón. Rovnaké alebo odlišné?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Z boxu 1 do boxu 2 s citom
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: E and A shapes up the neck, major and minor, the closer shape, and a progression in A.
rows.translation: Hmaty E a A vyššie na krku, dur a mol, bližší hmat a akordový sled v A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
rows.translation: Vaše F je hmat E s barré na pražci 1. Posuňte ho celý nahor a názov sa mení podľa základného tónu na strune 6: na pražci 3 je G, na pražci 5 je A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
rows.translation: Barré s hmatom E na pražci 5. Ktorý akord?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
rows.translation: Struna 6 stúpa od E: F na 1, G na 3, A na 5. Pražec barré určuje názov akordu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
rows.translation: Zdvihnite prst 2 a nechajte barré pritlačiť strunu 3. To je hmat E mol a posúva sa rovnako: Fis mol na pražci 2, A mol na pražci 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Hmat A, základný tón na strune 5
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
rows.translation: B mol bol hmat A mol s barré. Posúvať sa dá aj durový hmat A: barré cez struny 1 až 5, potom prst 3 naplocho cez struny 4, 3 a 2 o dva pražce vyššie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: An A-shape barre at fret 3. Which chord?
rows.translation: Barré s hmatom A na pražci 3. Ktorý akord?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Struna 5 stúpa od A: B na 2, C na 3, D na 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The minor A shape moves too
rows.translation: Posúva sa aj molový hmat A
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
rows.translation: Pri mole použite prstoklad B mol: prsty 2, 3 a 4 vytvoria pred barré hmat A mol. Na pražci 3 je to C mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
rows.translation: Väčšinu akordov možno hrať hmatom E so základným tónom na strune 6 alebo hmatom A so základným tónom na strune 5. Vyberte ten bližší k aktuálnej polohe ruky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: You're playing G at fret 3. Where's the closest C?
rows.translation: Hráte G na pražci 3. Kde je najbližšie C?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Stay at fret 3 and switch to the A shape.
rows.translation: Základný tón C je na strune 5, pražci 3. Zostaňte na pražci 3 a prejdite na hmat A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Keep the barre, swap the shape
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From G to C at fret 3, finger 1 stays on the barre. Only the fingers in front of it change. It's the smoothest barre change there is.
rows.translation: Pri zmene z G na C na pražci 3 zostáva prst 1 na barré. Menia sa iba prsty pred ním. Je to najplynulejšia zmena barré akordov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D as an A shape sits at which fret?
rows.translation: Na ktorom pražci je D hrané hmatom A?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 5: A open, B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Struna 5: prázdne A, B na 2, C na 3, D na 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A, E
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A and E all live in the key of A. Start with F sharp minor as a barre and the other three open.
rows.translation: Fis mol, D, A a E patria do tóniny A. Začnite s Fis mol ako barré a ostatnými tromi otvorenými akordmi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: F sharp minor as an E-shape barre sits at…
rows.translation: Fis mol ako barré s hmatom E je na…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 6: F at fret 1, F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Struna 6: F na pražci 1, Fis na pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play it up the neck: F sharp minor at fret 2, D as an A shape at fret 5, A as an E shape at fret 5, and E as an A shape at fret 7.
rows.translation: Zahrajte vyššie na krku: Fis mol na pražci 2, D hmatom A na pražci 5, A hmatom E na pražci 5 a E hmatom A na pražci 7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
rows.translation: Pri presune barré na okamih uvoľnite a pri dopade znova pritlačte. Neustály silný stisk unavuje ruku a spomaľuje zmenu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?
rows.translation: Kedy má ruka na hmatníku pevne stláčať?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
rows.translation: Pri dosadnutí pritlačte, pri pohybe uvoľnite. Neustála sila unaví ruku za pár minút.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On the last up strum before a change, lift the barre and keep strumming. The open strings sound for a moment, the rhythm never stops, and you land on time.
rows.translation: Pri poslednom brnknutí nahor pred zmenou zdvihnite barré a brnkajte ďalej. Prázdne struny na chvíľu zaznejú, rytmus sa nezastaví a nový akord zahráte načas.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is a Timbre Original: indie pop in E on E, B, C sharp minor and A. B and C sharp minor are both A-shape barres, two frets apart, so one hand shape does most of the work. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Úsvit nasprejovaný farbou je autorská pieseň Timbre: indie pop v E na E, B, Cis mol a A. B aj Cis mol sú barré s hmatom A, vzdialené dva pražce, takže väčšinu práce zvládne jeden tvar ruky. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C sharp minor as an A minor shape barre sits at…
rows.translation: Cis mol ako barré s hmatom A mol je na…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, C sharp at 4.
rows.translation: Struna 5 stúpa od A: B na 2, C na 3, Cis na 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: E and A shapes, major and minor, choosing the closer shape and smooth changes. Relax between chords and land on beat one.
rows.translation: Nič nové: durové aj molové hmaty E a A, výber bližšieho hmatu a plynulé zmeny. Medzi akordmi uvoľnite ruku a nový akord zahrajte na prvú dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 3 is…
rows.translation: Barré s hmatom E na pražci 3 je…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Root on string 5 means which shape?
rows.translation: Ktorý hmat má základný tón na strune 5?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Funk sixteenths and scratches, the reggae chop, country boom-chick and a syncopated pop strum.
rows.translation: Funkové šestnástiny a tlmené údery, reggae sekanie, country bum-čik a synkopovaný popový rytmus.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Sixteenth notes split each beat in four: one-e-and-a, two-e-and-a. Your strumming hand doubles its speed, down-up-down-up inside every beat.
rows.translation: Šestnástinové noty delia každú dobu na štyri: raz-e-a-da, dva-e-a-da. Brnkajúca ruka zdvojnásobí rýchlosť: nadol-nahor-nadol-nahor počas každej doby.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fill one beat?
rows.translation: Koľko šestnástinových nôt vyplní jednu dobu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: One-e-and-a: four even slices of every beat.
rows.translation: Raz-e-a-da: štyri rovnaké časti každej doby.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Funk loves the ninth chord. Finger 2 on string 5, fret 7, finger 1 on string 4, fret 6, and finger 3 flat across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7.
rows.translation: Funk miluje nónové akordy. Prst 2 na strune 5, pražci 7, prst 1 na strune 4, pražci 6 a prst 3 naplocho cez struny 3, 2 a 1 na pražci 7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Rukou sa pohybujte v šestnástinách, ale prsty na hmatníku uvoľnite, aby väčšina brnknutí znela ako suché tlmené cvaknutie. Pritlačte iba pri znejúcich úderoch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fretting fingers resting lightly on the strings
rows.translation: Prsty hmatníkovej ruky ľahko na strunách
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Touching without pressing stops the strings from ringing. The strum turns into a crisp, percussive click.
rows.translation: Dotyk bez pritlačenia zastaví znenie strún. Brnknutie sa zmení na jasné, perkusívne cvaknutie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Squeeze for each hit, then relax right away so it stays short. Slide the whole E9 shape down two frets and you have D9.
rows.translation: Pri každom údere pritlačte a hneď uvoľnite, aby zostal krátky. Posuňte celý hmat E9 o dva pražce nadol a získate D9.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Reggae guitar answers the drums with short, bright chords on beats two and four. Strum just the thin strings and cut each chord off right away.
rows.translation: Reggae gitara odpovedá bicím krátkymi, jasnými akordmi na druhú a štvrtú dobu. Brnkajte iba cez tenké struny a každý akord hneď utlmte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Use the top four strings only. This A minor is the top of your A minor barre at fret 5: finger 3 on string 4, fret 7, finger 1 barring the rest.
rows.translation: Používajte iba štyri najvyššie struny. Toto A mol je vrch vášho barré A mol na pražci 5: prst 3 na strune 4, pražci 7 a prst 1 tvorí barré na ostatných.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How long should a reggae chop ring?
rows.translation: Ako dlho má reggae sekanie znieť?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Squeeze, strum, release. The chop is a short bark, and the space after it is the groove.
rows.translation: Pritlačte, brnknite, uvoľnite. Sekanie je krátke šteknutie a rytmus tvorí aj priestor po ňom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now the top of your D barre: finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 7, finger 1 on string 1 at fret 5.
rows.translation: Teraz vrch vášho barré D: prst 3 naplocho cez struny 4, 3 a 2 na pražci 7, prst 1 na strune 1 na pražci 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Country rhythm splits the bar: a single bass note on beats one and three, a quick strum of the thin strings on two and four. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
rows.translation: Country rytmus rozdelí takt: jeden basový tón na prvú a tretiu dobu, rýchle brnknutie cez tenké struny na druhú a štvrtú. Bum, čik, bum, čik.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In boom-chick, what happens on beats two and four?
rows.translation: Čo sa pri bum-čik deje na druhú a štvrtú dobu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A short strum of the thin strings
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Move the second boom to another string: in G, string 6 then string 4. In C, string 5 then 4. In D, string 4 then open string 5.
rows.translation: Druhé bum presuňte na inú strunu: v G struna 6, potom struna 4. V C struna 5, potom 4. V D struna 4, potom prázdna struna 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Booms in G, C and D
rows.translation: Basové údery v G, C a D
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Syncopation puts the strum where you don't expect it. Down on one, up on the and of two, up on the and of three, then down-up on four.
rows.translation: Synkopa umiestni brnknutie tam, kde ho nečakáte. Nadol na prvú dobu, nahor na „a“ druhej, nahor na „a“ tretej a potom nadol-nahor na štvrtú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In this pattern, what does your hand do on beat two?
rows.translation: Čo robí ruka na druhú dobu v tomto vzore?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The pendulum never stops. On two the hand swings down without touching, ready for the up strum.
rows.translation: Kyvadlo sa nikdy nezastaví. Na druhú dobu ruka ide nadol bez dotyku, pripravená na brnknutie nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pop players often change chords on the last up strum, the and of four, so the new chord arrives a hair early. It pushes the song forward.
rows.translation: Popoví gitaristi často menia akord pri poslednom brnknutí nahor, na „a“ štvrtej doby. Nový akord tak príde o chĺpok skôr a posúva pieseň dopredu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The pop strum on four chords
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Sparkler Season is a Timbre Original: a summer anthem in C on C, G, A minor and F. Give it the syncopated pop strum, and change a hair early, on the and of four. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Sezóna prskaviek je autorská pieseň Timbre: letná hymna v C na C, G, A mol a F. Zahrajte synkopovaný popový rytmus a akordy meňte o chĺpok skôr, na „a“ štvrtej doby. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open E and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, then G at fret 3 on string 1, and back down to D.
rows.translation: Prázdne E a D na pražci 3 struny 2 dvakrát, potom G na pražci 3 struny 1 a späť nadol na D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Why change chords on the and of four?
rows.translation: Prečo meniť akord na „a“ štvrtej doby?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: So the new chord rings on beat one
rows.translation: Aby nový akord znel na prvú dobu
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Moving on the last up strum gets your hand there a hair early, so the new chord is ready for beat one.
rows.translation: Presun pri poslednom brnknutí nahor dostane ruku na miesto o chĺpok skôr, takže nový akord je pripravený na prvú dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: funk sixteenths, the reggae chop, boom-chick and the syncopated pop strum. Keep the hand swinging and change only what it hits.
rows.translation: Nič nové: funkové šestnástiny, reggae sekanie, bum-čik a synkopovaný popový rytmus. Rukou stále pohybujte a meňte iba to, čo zasiahne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Reggae chops land on which beats?
rows.translation: Na ktoré doby pripadá reggae sekanie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A capo, G and D shapes on capo 2, and Oh! Susanna arranged with a verse and a chorus.
rows.translation: Kapodaster, hmaty G a D s kapodastrom na 2 a Oh! Susanna so slohou aj refrénom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A capo clamps every string at one fret. On fret 2, each open string sounds two frets higher, and your open chord shapes all move up with it.
rows.translation: Kapodaster pritlačí každú strunu na jednom pražci. Na pražci 2 znie každá prázdna struna o dva pražce vyššie a všetky otvorené hmaty sa posunú s ňou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Before the capo: pluck strings 1 and 2 open. That's E and B.
rows.translation: Pred kapodastrom: brnknite na prázdne struny 1 a 2. To sú E a B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now clamp the capo just behind fret 2 and pluck them again: F sharp and C sharp.
rows.translation: Teraz upnite kapodaster tesne pri pražci 2 zo strany hlavy a brnknite znova: Fis a Cis.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. You play a G shape. Which chord sounds?
rows.translation: Kapodaster na pražci 2. Hráte hmat G. Ktorý akord znie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Two frets up from G is A. The shape stays G; the sound moves up with the capo.
rows.translation: O dva pražce nad G je A. Hmat zostáva G, ale zvuk sa s kapodastrom posunie nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: With a capo you still think G, C and D, the shapes you know. The diagrams here name the chord you actually hear, so a G shape on capo 2 reads A.
rows.translation: S kapodastrom stále myslíte na známe hmaty G, C a D. Diagramy tu však pomenúvajú skutočne znejúci akord, takže hmat G s kapodastrom na 2 je označený A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G and D shapes on capo 2
rows.translation: Hmaty G a D s kapodastrom na 2
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The G family, two frets up
rows.translation: Rodina G o dva pražce vyššie
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On capo 2, G, C, D and E minor shapes sound as A, D, E and F sharp minor. Same fingers, new key: A major.
rows.translation: S kapodastrom na 2 znejú hmaty G, C, D a E mol ako A, D, E a Fis mol. Rovnaké prsty, nová tónina: A dur.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. A D shape sounds as…
rows.translation: Kapodaster na pražci 2. Hmat D znie ako…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Two frets above D is E.
rows.translation: O dva pražce nad D je E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D shapes work the same way. On capo 2, D, G and A shapes sound as E, A and B: the key of E with easy open fingerings.
rows.translation: Hmaty D fungujú rovnako. S kapodastrom na 2 znejú hmaty D, G a A ako E, A a B: tónina E s ľahkými otvorenými hmatmi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Most songs alternate two sections. The verse tells the story; the chorus repeats the hook. Stephen Foster's Oh! Susanna (1848) has both. Capo off: it's in G.
rows.translation: Väčšina piesní strieda dve časti. Sloha rozpráva príbeh, refrén opakuje hlavný motív. Oh! Susanna od Stephena Fostera (1848) má obe. Bez kapodastra: je v G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The pickup and first bar: open G, A at fret 2, then open B, D at fret 3 twice, and open E.
rows.translation: Predtakt a prvý takt: prázdne G, A na pražci 2, potom prázdne B, dvakrát D na pražci 3 a prázdne E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which section usually comes back with the same words?
rows.translation: Ktorá časť sa zvyčajne vracia s rovnakými slovami?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Verses change their words as the story moves on. The chorus returns unchanged, and that's what people sing along to.
rows.translation: Text slôh sa s vývojom príbehu mení. Refrén sa vracia nezmenený a ľudia ho spievajú spolu s piesňou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Back the verse with G and D7, boom-chick style: bass on one, strum on two. Three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Slohu sprevádzajte G a D7 v štýle bum-čik: bas na prvú dobu, akord na druhú. Tri takty G, jeden D7, dva G, potom D7 a G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
